Job Title: Full Stack Software Engineer
Company: CloudScale Systems
Location: Seattle, WA (Remote Eligible)

About the Role:
CloudScale Systems is looking for a versatile Full Stack Software Engineer to build scalable customer-facing web applications and resilient microservices. You will collaborate across disciplines to deliver responsive interfaces and high-concurrency cloud backends that empower our global go-to-market enterprise solutions. Candidates of all academic backgrounds, regardless of whether you held a Grade C or honors distinction, are encouraged to demonstrate practical craftsmanship.

Minimum Experience:
Minimum 3+ years of professional software engineering experience delivering production web services.

Key Responsibilities:
• Develop modern, accessible frontend web interfaces using JavaScript and component-based React architecture.
• Build modular server-side REST APIs and microservice endpoints powered by Node.js.
• Maintain clean version control practices, conduct code reviews, and manage pull requests using Git.
• Containerize microservices and deploy service components using Docker environments.
• Coordinate cluster scheduling and service orchestration across Kubernetes cloud clusters.
• Write concurrent backend backend worker services and networking utilities utilizing Go.

Required Qualifications:
• Strong proficiency in modern JavaScript development (ES6+) and web browser fundamentals.
• Production experience building dynamic user interfaces with React.
• Solid background creating backend API services utilizing Node.js.
• Rigorous discipline in collaborative version control and release workflows using Git.
• Minimum 3 years of software engineering experience.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Working experience containerizing applications using Docker containers.
• Hands-on familiarity with Kubernetes container orchestration.
• Practical knowledge of concurrent systems programming in Go.
• Experience working with TypeScript in large codebase architectures.
